attempts.summary: Installed podman on node1, created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges, enabled systemd linger for appsvc, and deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) as a user-level systemd unit (webapp.service, WantedBy=default.target) publishing port 8080. Verified the app serves HTTP 200 on $NODE_IP:8080 while appsvc has zero active login sessions. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed post-reboot, and verified webapp.service came back active/enabled and serving HTTP 200 on port 8080 with still no login session for appsvc.
